questions.prompt: What should the comparison run on Agent CI?
questions.description: The recommended design runs the same pinned workflow revision on Preloop and Agent CI, using equivalent runner labels and collecting both timing and outcome data.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Run the same pinned workflow revision on both systems and compare end-to-end and phase timings.

questions.prompt: How many repetitions should each repository receive?
questions.description: The recommendation separates cold-start behavior from warm-run behavior so VM boot/resume effects are visible without making the campaign unnecessarily large.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Three cold-start runs and five warm runs per system and repository, with failures retained rather than retried away.

questions.prompt: Are public repositories at pinned revisions acceptable?
questions.description: The benchmark needs reproducible source and workflow inputs. The recommended selection is five public small-to-medium repositories spanning Rust, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and a container-heavy or monorepo-style CI workload.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Use public repositories at pinned commits; select five diverse projects with no private credentials required beyond Agent CI access.

questions.prompt: What Agent CI access and execution surface should the goal assume?
questions.description: The benchmark plan will keep credentials out of the repository and record setup prerequisites explicitly.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Use the Agent CI account, CLI, or API credentials already available in the environment; do not commit or print secrets.
